newsitem.title: USA: GOLF-SCORES AT ST. JUDE CLASSIC IN FIRST ROUND.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-SCORES AT ST. JUDE CLASSIC IN FIRST ROUND.

text.p: Leading scores at the $1.5 million St. Jude Classic when first-round play was suspended Thursday due to darkness with 78 of the 155 golfers yet to complete their rounds (players U.S. unless stated, 18 holes completed unless stated):
5-under Nick Price (Zimbabwe), Kenny Perry, Craig Kanada, Doug Martin (through 16 holes), Stewart Cink (16), Lennie Clements (11)

4-under Mike Hulbert, John Wilson, Robin Freeman, D.A. Weibring, Mike Springer, Curtis Strange, Russ Cochran, Kelly Gibson, Bradley Hughes (Australia) David Berganio (9), Tommy Armour (15), Justin Leonard (12)
3-under Fulton Allem (South Africa), Greg Norman (Australia, 14 holes)
